sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a canonical marking-to-hullStructure path: the marking terms are Classes rather than linking properties, hullStructure is a Class, and the only supplied ObjectProperty links markings to colour values.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: markingPlateThickness, markingWeldedToShipSide, reflectingMarkingColour, and markingPlainlyVisibleInIceConditions have authoritative requiredOwner hullStructure, but the candidate constrains them directly on iceClassDraughtMarking and warningTriangleMarking nodes.
